summary: The Imperator Citadel is the supreme seat of Muramite authority — a colossal fortress where the Imperator rules, warlords gather, and Dominion strategy is forged. It is the most secure and politically powerful location in the entire Muramite Dominion.
history: Constructed after the Muramite unification under the first Imperator.
Imperator Hall became the center of Dominion governance and military command.
Dominion Sanctum was established as the ritual and ceremonial heart of Muramite culture.
The Throne of Command was forged from Discord‑infused alloy, symbolizing absolute authority.
The Citadel became the strategic hub for the Kuua invasion and future planar campaigns.
